status: frozen development research protocol; not final paper specification
training_type: standalone synchronous PPO; frozen-policy asynchronous deployment evaluation
training_paths: random sine: amplitude 0.5-3 m, wavelength 100-180 m, phase uniform [-pi,pi]
worker_policy: one in-flight job, no backlog; drop requests while busy, reject out-of-order results
simulated_delay_note: fixed service time per cell; nonblocking local control; separately record measured wall inference time
claims: budget completion and observed evaluation only; no convergence/stability/general-superiority guarantee

state_estimator.type: linear Kalman with common noisy ey/heading/yaw-rate observations; measured actuator and speed inputs
state_estimator.note: 10ms forward-Euler observer; no differentiation of white noise; no true lateral velocity supplied
